name: totp-cli
description: totp-cli — TOTP/HOTP token generator CLI. Generate time-based one-time passwords for 2FA from command line.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/yitsushi/totp-cli/releases/download/v1.6.0/totp-cli-v1.6.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf totp-cli-v1.6.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv totp-cli /usr/local/bin/ && rm totp-cli-v1.6.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz

commands.description: totp-cli — TOTP/HOTP token generator CLI. Generate time-based one-time passwords for 2FA from command line.
